messages.author: zmatovic.kg.ac.rs
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
Hope you are all healthy and in good mood,
Just a quest or a kind request:
Does any one have .mol2 or .pdb file of alpha- and beta-cyclodextrin with
appropriate glycam atom names? If so will you please send it to me; its
tricky job (for me) to find a solution.
Regards,
Zoran
A true friend is someone who is there for you
when he'd rather be anywhere else.
-- Len Wein
